1592550875.title: Unauthorized Bluetooth Connection Issue with boAt Rockerz 255 Pro+
1592550875.text:
Dear boAt Support Team,

I recently purchased a boAt Rockerz 255 Pro+ neckband and am facing a serious Bluetooth connectivity issue.

While I am connected to my device, nearby users are sometimes able to connect to the neckband automatically without my permission. When this happens, my audio playback stops, and I can hear audio or voice from the other user’s device. This raises concerns regarding both privacy and security.

I have also installed the boAt Hearables iOS app, but Rockerz 255 Pro+ does not appear in the list of supported devices, so I am unable to manage any connection or pairing settings through the app.

Could you please help me with the following:

How can I prevent unauthorized devices from connecting to my neckband?
Is there a way to make the device private or require permission before pairing?
Is there any firmware update available to resolve this issue?
If this is a hardware or firmware defect, what are the available replacement or warranty options?
I have already tried resetting and reconnecting the device, but the issue persists.

I would appreciate your assistance in resolving this matter as soon as possible.

Thank you.

Best regards,
Arabaz Ahamad
